title: The courier trial
passage: A quick update on our courier trial. An ordinary order can go in the afternoon van only if a supervisor approves it before noon and the van reaches the receiving desk while it is still open. Approved safety-critical orders can go in the morning van instead. The driver can leave those at the staffed gate if the desk is closed. If an ordinary order misses either requirement, hold it until tomorrow. The ordinary gasket order was approved at ten thirty, but its desk closes at three. The afternoon van gets there at three thirty. We can't pull a rabbit out of a hat.
passageZh: 簡短更新一下試行中的送貨安排。一般訂單只有在主管中午前核准，且貨車抵達收貨櫃台時櫃台仍然開放，才能搭下午的貨車。已核准且攸關安全的訂單則可改搭上午的貨車。如果櫃台關了，司機可把這類貨物交給有值班人員的大門。一般訂單若有任一條件沒達成，就留到明天。這筆一般墊片訂單在十點半獲得核准，但收貨櫃台三點關閉。下午的貨車三點半才到。這種情況，我們臨時可變不出什麼奇招。
